bio_text: Lydia Hallie is a software engineer, developer experience specialist, and prolific technical educator best known for her visual, in-depth JavaScript and web platform content — including a GitHub repo with 65k+ stars and multiple Frontend Masters courses. She is currently on the Claude Code team at Anthropic, where she focuses on developer experience and technical education, having previously led DX at Bun and worked as a Staff DX Engineer at Vercel. She bridges the worlds of high-quality technical content creation and product-level developer tooling, with deep expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and the modern web runtime ecosystem.
